meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Payment System Indicators (via DBIE)
meta.revisionPolicy: Monthly figures are provisional when first printed and may be revised in later Bulletins; the RBI re-organised the table in November 2019, and the two layouts are kept apart.
meta.coverage: The average size of one payment, month by month, for every retail payment system and cash withdrawal line: UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, cards, wallets, cheques, ATMs
meta.note: Derived: the value of a line divided by its number of transactions, both from RBI Bulletin Table 45 (DBIE report 612), same line and month. A mean, pulled up by a few large payments; not the typical payment.
